title: calamagrostis plebeia
intro: Calamagrostis plebeia, commonly known as small fescue grass, is a type of grass species in the Poaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation. The plant is also known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Calamagrostis plebeia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
